'''Yahk-Tosh''' was the [[Language/Legends|language]] spoken by members of the [[Yahk-Tosh]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. When [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Gar-Oth]] invaded a [[Lourdes' homeworld|small planetoid]], his [[Jilruan/Legends|Jilruan]] attendants translated his words from Yahk-Tosh.
